SELECT
  created_on as time,
  meter_name,
  kwh AS "VOL PACK CHILLER"
FROM
  hul.energy_usage
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(created_on)
  AND meter_name IN ('4F3-32A|VOLPACKCHILLER')
ORDER BY
  created_on;

SELECT
    meter_name AS MeterName,
    SUM(kwh)/1000 AS "Total Energy Usage (MWh)"
FROM
    hul.energy_usage
WHERE
    $__timeFilter(created_on)
    AND meter_name IN ('1F2-125A|FLAXLINKCONVEYORPANELLOOP3&4', '2F4-63A|BL-3,SHRINKTUNNALM/C', '3F2-160A|110VUPS', '2F2-160A|BEEMWEARHOUSECHARGINGPOINT', '2F1-100A|ROBOTDELTAUPS', '3F5-32A|POSIMATMCBL', '3F6-32A|AUTOPACK', '4F2-32A|BOTTLINGLINECONVEYOR', '4F4-32A|BOTTLINGLINE03CONVEYOR', '2F3-63A|VOLPACK', '2F7-32|VOLPACKCLDFORMMINGMACHINE', '3F1-200A|FLEXLINKCONVEYORPANELLOOP1&2', '2F2-32A|MIXER08VACUMELIFTER', '2F2-63A|VIMVOLPACKCASHPACKER', '2F3-32A|VIMVOLPACKCASHPACKERCONVEYOR', '3F2-63A|TJBYPASSCONVEYOR', '3F5-100A|LOOP6&7FLXLINKCONVEYORPANEL', '4F3-32A|BLCLDMAKINGM/C', '5F1-12A|MIXER-08HOMONIGERPUMP', '5F4-50A|YSTRALMIXER08', '4R2-32A|BLPOSIMATALPINECONVEYOR', '4R3-32A|BOTTELLINE3LEBLINGMACHINE', '2F1-63A', '2F2-63A', '2F3-63A')
GROUP BY
    meter_name
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN meter_name = '1F2-125A|FLAXLINKCONVEYORPANELLOOP3&4' THEN 1
        WHEN meter_name = '2F4-63A|BL-3,SHRINKTUNNALM/C' THEN 2
        WHEN meter_name = '3F2-160A|110VUPS' THEN 3
        WHEN meter_name = '2F2-160A|BEEMWEARHOUSECHARGINGPOINT' THEN 4
        WHEN meter_name = '2F1-100A|ROBOTDELTAUPS' THEN 5
        WHEN meter_name = '3F5-32A|POSIMATMCBL' THEN 6
        WHEN meter_name = '3F6-32A|AUTOPACK' THEN 7
        WHEN meter_name = '4F2-32A|BOTTLINGLINECONVEYOR' THEN 8
        WHEN meter_name = '4F4-32A|BOTTLINGLINE03CONVEYOR' THEN 9
        WHEN meter_name = '2F3-63A|VOLPACK' THEN 10
        WHEN meter_name = '2F7-32|VOLPACKCLDFORMMINGMACHINE' THEN 11
        WHEN meter_name = '3F1-200A|FLEXLINKCONVEYORPANELLOOP1&2' THEN 12
        WHEN meter_name = '2F2-32A|MIXER08VACUMELIFTER' THEN 13
        WHEN meter_name = '2F2-63A|VIMVOLPACKCASHPACKER' THEN 14
        WHEN meter_name = '2F3-32A|VIMVOLPACKCASHPACKERCONVEYOR' THEN 15
        WHEN meter_name = '3F2-63A|TJBYPASSCONVEYOR' THEN 16
        WHEN meter_name = '3F5-100A|LOOP6&7FLXLINKCONVEYORPANEL' THEN 17
        WHEN meter_name = '4F3-32A|BLCLDMAKINGM/C' THEN 18
        WHEN meter_name = '5F1-12A|MIXER-08HOMONIGERPUMP' THEN 19
        WHEN meter_name = '5F4-50A|YSTRALMIXER08' THEN 20
        WHEN meter_name = '4R2-32A|BLPOSIMATALPINECONVEYOR' THEN 21
        WHEN meter_name = '4R3-32A|BOTTELLINE3LEBLINGMACHINE' THEN 22
        WHEN meter_name = '2F1-63A' THEN 23
        WHEN meter_name = '2F2-63A' THEN 24
        WHEN meter_name = '2F3-63A' THEN 25
    END;
